visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular man wearing a black tank top and a black helmet rides a white, blue, and black sport motorcycle into a bright outdoor gas station. He pulls up next to a fuel pump labeled with a red '2'. (2) The man stops the bike, and a gas station attendant in a blue and yellow uniform with a reflective vest approaches him. The rider gestures with his right hand while talking. (3) The rider removes his helmet to reveal his face, then leans against the motorcycle while speaking directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. The background shows gas pumps and street scenery. (4) He holds a black smartphone close to the camera, displaying an app interface with various colorful product icons like 'Minsheng food' and 'Home appliances'. He scrolls through the list using his thumb. (5) Inside a brightly lit convenience store, the man stands at a white counter. A staff member hands him three large, heavy-looking cardboard boxes. The man's facial expression shifts to one of surprise and exertion. (6) The man carries the three stacked boxes out of the store entrance, which has a 'Welcome' sign in Chinese. He walks towards his motorcycle, looking around as if searching for a place to put them. (7) He leans on the bike, holding a branded paper cup and taking a drink. Animated text overlays and graphics appear around him showing discount codes and point values. (8) The man rides away on the motorcycle with the three boxes precariously balanced on the passenger seat behind him.

The main speaker begins a professional narrative tone, speaking with high energy and clarity about app features. (3) A female voice asks a brief, inquisitive question. A 'ding' SFX sounds as the male speaker answers with high-pitched excitement. (4) Inside the store, the background music continues at a lower volume. Sound of boxes sliding and moving occurs. (5) Cartoon-style 'boing' and comic SFX are layered over the speech as the man expresses surprise. (6) Music intensity increases during the promotional section. A hard cut occurs as the speaker delivers a final comedic line with a higher pitch contour.
